description: Norfolk Highways Centre Line Network is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Norfolk County Council. The Norfolk highways centre line network data is a digital representation of the centre lines of all the roads in Norfolk that are maintainable at public expense by Norfolk County Council. Download our Norfolk Highways Centre Line Network data in KMZ (Keyhole Markup Language Zipped) format, from related downloads on this page. Coverage: Norfolk County Council. The portal files it under the publisher Norfolk County Council. It offers 1 resource(s) in KMZ. The portal shows 2025-10-30 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
